sv.title: Brister i Sveriges skydd mot spionage och terrorism
sv.summary: Svenska myndigheter har hittat brister i säkerhetsarbetet hos flera samhällsviktiga verksamheter inom bland annat infrastruktur, och energiförsörjning, visar en granskning som Sveriges Radios Ekot har gjort.

en.title: Shortcomings in Sweden's protection against espionage and terrorism
en.summary: Swedish authorities have found shortcomings in the security work of several societally important operations, including in infrastructure and energy supply, according to a review conducted by Ekot, Sveriges Radio.
